pos.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung calls Atlético a counter-team even in forced possession, and Simeone asked for a fast counter-attacking side; possession is not emphasised (TFT).

pro.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice notes build-up in midfield after a direct ball, and Spielverlagerung describes rapid breakthroughs after regains.

est.personaBrief: A deep, narrow 4-4-2 with defined roles and zones; wingers sit in midfield and strikers work toward the midfield.

lar.personaBrief: Vice and Spielverlagerung: nobody plays as an outright winger, midfield is crowded centrally, and width comes from full-backs.

blo.personaBrief: Compact deep 4-4-2 and low block to protect leads, but also heavy early pressing, forwards pressing centre-backs and counter-pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Full-backs man-mark wingers within a compact zonal shape (Spielverlagerung), though TFT says marking is not rigidly man-oriented.

pla.personaBrief: Strong imposed identity and partido a partido, with some tactical adaptability such as 4-1-4-1 against Chelsea.

res.personaBrief: Result-first: live day by day, effort over talent, low block to protect leads, work to compete.

sis.personaBrief: Collective above individual, effort over talent, internal competition; everyone does their job.

jog.personaBrief: Combative, intense players; effort over talent (Oliver benched); combative central midfielders; Costa archetype.

bas.personaBrief: Picks the best team regardless of origin, relies on experienced leaders like Gabi and Godin and buys proven players; youth development is not central.

lid.personaBrief: Hard-line authority, discipline, internal competition, captain as alter ego; no special treatment for stars.
